nom: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum

segments.dry: The large majority of reviewers with dry skin, including post-menopausal and eczema-adjacent dryness, report calmer, plumper, better-hydrated skin, with visible relief for dry patches around the nose, chin or cheeks; one reviewer notes the watery texture may not be enough alone for very dry skin without layering.
segments.sensitive: The large majority with sensitive skin, including some rebuilding their routine after reactions to other products, report no irritation or redness and real calming and hydration; the one critical review specifically warns sensitive and acne-prone users to patch-test first after breaking out.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (often also acne-prone) skin report fewer breakouts, reduced inflammation, and a non-greasy hydrated finish.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 50s and post-menopausal report a strong hydration boost and, in two cases, a visible filling-in or softening of fine lines and wrinkles.
segments.normal: The two reviewers with normal (one leaning sensitive) skin report a soothing, hydrating effect with no redness.
segments.oily: The one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found it hydrating enough to skip her usual moisturizer, with her makeup holding up better throughout the day.

concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority report a strong, fast hydration boost — plumper, softer skin and calmer dry patches, sometimes noticeable after a single use. A handful found it only mildly hydrating or too watery to feel like enough on its own, especially for very dry skin without layering a cream on top.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or combination-acne skin report fewer breakouts and reduced inflammation, with several noting no new breakouts at all. One reviewer's skin broke out on this serum and she recommends sensitive or acne-prone users patch-test before adding it to their routine.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea or reactive skin, report less redness or that existing redness soothes with use; no reviewer reports the product causing redness.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the serum with strengthening or balancing the skin barrier, including one whose sunburned skin recovered faster with it.
concerns.aging: Several reviewers report a visible softening of fine lines and wrinkles, in one case comparing the effect to filler after her skin had aged noticeably following a too-basic sensitive-skin routine.

aspects.libelle: Faint fishy scent bothers a few
Layers well under makeup, no pilling

extraits.texte: Unfortunately, this serum didn't work for my skin. I know everyone's skin is different, and it may work well for others, but it just wasn't a good fit for me. If you have sensitive or acne-prone skin, I'd recommend introducing it slowly and doing a patch test before adding it to your daily routine.

This is my first time writing a review on Ulta but felt I really need to for this product. I recently had to ditch my entire skincare routine and am rebuilding it from scratch due to new sensitivities and changing skin care needs in my early 40s. When I went to all sensitive skincare products with zero actives my skin's inflammation, acne, and rosacea cleared up almost immediately, but then my skin seemed to look 5 years older in the course of a month because most of the products for super sensitive skin are very basic and have minimal additives or actives like hyaluronic acid which will add moisture and fill in your fine lines. I then started the slow process of rebuilding a skin-care regimen that would be good for my sensitive skin and target my aesthetic anti-aging wants and needs. Over the course of the last several months I've wasted so so much money on finding good products that make my skin look good without bringing the inflammation and acne back. However, THIS product has been great for both my sensitive skin and my other skincare wants. The hyaluronic acid has nicely hydrated my skin which has filled in all the fine lines that formed. It was like getting thousands of dollars of filler. The niacinamide is shrinking my pores. My face has a nice glowy/hydrated look with no redness. I have been applying it right after I wash my face while my skin is still wet. It just take a couple drops of the serum. I think the bottle will last at least 4 months with how much you need

This along with the pads and cream has had a huge POSITIVE impact on my dry, aging skin! I've gone through so many skincare brands trying to find the right regimen for my post menopausal, dry, patchy skin, but nothing comes close to hydrating my skin like this!I saw a difference after 1 use!

extraits.titre: PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Serum— Must try!
extraits.texte: I'm so impressed with the results! As someone with dry, sensitive skin that's prone to redness and dehydration, finding a serum that actually works without irritation has been a challenge. This one might be a new favorite. The serum combines PDRN (derived from salmon DNA which I have been dying to try) with hyaluronic acid to deeply hydrate and repair skin. I used it twice daily after cleansing, applying it to damp skin before moisturizer. The lightweight gel texture absorbs fast - no sticky residue! I noticed my skin felt significantly plumped and hydrated. My usual dry patches, the redness I get occasionally soothes, and makeup application became much smoother without flakiness. The dropper bottle is elegant but I wish there was more product. Ideal for dry/dehydrated/sensitive types needing repair + moisture. I will repurchase! (tip: Apply to damp skin for best results.) **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.

My combination acne prone skin loves this,it intensely hydrates my skin and strengthens my skin barrier as I noticed that my breakouts and inflammation have reduced overtime.i also noticed an overall brighter and radiant skin glow.i will definitely keep using this in my routine the serum was provided for promotional purposes and in exchange for my honest review.

With my oily and acne-prone skin type, I've always struggled with my makeup sliding off after 4-5 hours, regardless of how much primer and setting spray I used. One day, I stumbled upon a video of a Korean makeup artist using this product as a skin prep for her client. Intrigued, I decided to give it a try, and it completely transformed my makeup routine. It provides a healthy, radiant finish and is incredibly hydrating, so I've eliminated the need for my usual moisturizer step. Instead, I apply Anua's PDRN and sunscreen in the morning and proceed with my foundation. Surprisingly, my makeup doesn't melt or smudge throughout the entire workday. It's a game-changer! 💗🙌🏻

I really really like the results form this and anua's other products! They work seamlessly together! This surem is lightweight, it's doesn't leave a greasy residue, it great for my skin type (dry, sensitive) and all skin types , which is great!) The bootle is really nice, holds the products without leaks. I've noticed a change in my wrinkles alot! They are drastically less deep! This is the first products that I've noticed give a huge difference in my skin! I'm sure it's this plus other products in their line. (I'll add pictures) I definitely highly highly recommend this!
